specName: The spec viewer as an embeddable element
request: --number 670 Spec viewer as a library, slices V5, V6 (and the speckit-companion half of V9) of issue #983. Work ONLY in /Users/alfredoperez/dev/GitHub/speckit-companion.worktrees/feat-983-v5-v9 (branch feat/983-v5-v9-factory, already created; skip the before_specify branch hook). (1) V5: cut the spec viewer's view off from the VS Code host. Move the host-neutral Preact view (App shell, NavigationBar, StepTab, SpecHeader, PageChrome, ActivityPanel, ActivityErrorBoundary, OverviewDossier, RunStrip, TimelineEvent, ElapsedTimer, the read-only Overview cards, signals, toc, highlighting, documentLinks, the shared Badge/Button it needs) from apps/vscode/webview/src/spec-viewer into packages/viewer (a new /view entry, Preact components exported). Every vscode.postMessage in that view becomes one typed onAction(action) whose type is the existing ViewerToExtensionMessage union, exported from /contract as ViewerAction. Extension-only parts (inline editor and comments, footer actions, stale/removed/install banners, report pages, toast, message router, file-ref and checkbox handlers) stay in the extension and plug into the package App through slot props. The VS Code webview sets the action handler to vscode.postMessage. What a VS Code user sees must not change: prove it with tooling/scripts/viewer-style-diff.mjs (computed styles, every viewer story, vs a main build) and tooling/scripts/viewer-bundle-diff.mjs (report the diff; bundles will differ in code, behaviour must not), plus npm run check:vsix and npm run test:all. (2) V6: a /element entry registers <speckit-viewer> (Preact inside, light DOM so the scoped .sk-viewer CSS applies). Properties: record (the .spec-context.json, nullable), documents (the folder's documents: type, label, fileName, filePath, exists, core or related, parentStep), currentDoc, content (the current document's markdown text), landing (overview or document), live (boolean). The element derives NavState and ViewerState itself through /core, so the host-pure derivations it needs (phase calculation, step history derivation, viewer state derivation, badge/dates) move from apps/vscode/src into /core with the extension re-importing them. It emits every action as a bubbling, composed 'speckit-action' CustomEvent whose detail is the ViewerAction; navigation inside the viewer (rail clicks, document links between the folder's documents) is handled by the element itself and also emitted. Host-specific actions come in as slots: light-DOM children with slot="actions" are shown above the rail and document. It bundles highlight.js (11.9.0, the same languages the webview loads from the CDN today, plus its github-dark stylesheet in /styles), so it needs no CDN; the VS Code webview switches to the bundled highlighter too and drops the highlight.js CDN tags (mermaid stays CDN, opt-in). The package builds an ESM element bundle with esbuild (preact and highlight.js inside) and ships .d.ts. (3) The package source must type-check under noUncheckedIndexedAccess (Factory's strict tsconfig reported ~471 unchecked-index errors): turn the flag on in packages/viewer/tsconfig.json and fix the code, not the flag. Out of scope: moving stories to the package (V7), publishing (V8), the Copilot canvas (V10), the Claude Code mod (V11). No version bumps. No real VS Code windows; Storybook/headless Chrome only.
